interpretation: Plasma beta is the physical mediator of the coupling mechanism. Low beta (magnetically dominated) -> organized Alfvenic fluctuations -> strong phase coupling -> low associator. High beta (plasma dominated) -> compressive fluctuations -> disrupted coupling -> high associator. Boundary crossings are abrupt beta transitions. This connects Q2 (compressive modes elevate associator) to plasma physics: the compressive mode association is a beta effect.
